standing: Proposed C2PM-1 additive route extension: internal keys remain distinct from public envelope detail codes. Adds ONE public detail native.closure-protocol-invalid for known external closure-protocol failures; host bugs reuse HOST.INVARIANT_VIOLATED. D9 codes/classes/faults unchanged, existing route values preserved.
registryNullMeaning: domainDetail:null in the registry means OMIT termination.domainDetail. A failure envelope still requires errors: exactly one DomainDetail using the public envelopeDetail and code-keyed remedy, with bounded internal key as subject. Never emit null termination.domainDetail or an internal key as public code.
